findings.message: No SBR is signaled in the AudioSpecificConfig. SBR and PS can also be signaled implicitly, in the fill elements of the access units, which are not checked yet; the stream may be HE-AAC or HE-AAC v2.

The chan box of track 1 states stereo (front left, front right), but the AAC LC (no SBR signaled explicitly) stream states mono (front center); the stream may use parametric stereo signaled only inside its access units, which is not checked yet. The report gives the stream's channels.
